faq.title: Everything you need to know before buying

items.question: Is this really a one-time payment with no subscription?
items.answer: Yes. You pay once and keep Greta Studio v1.x forever—including all minor feature and security updates. No recurring monthly charges.

items.question: Does it work completely offline at remote venues?
items.answer: 100%. All image processing happens locally on your computer. Your photos never leave your drive, and Pro licenses stay active offline for up to 30 days between automatic check-ins.

items.question: What happens if I upgrade my laptop or format my PC?
items.answer: You can deactivate a computer directly inside Greta Studio's License window in one click, freeing that slot immediately for your new machine.

items.question: Does it support Apple Silicon Macs (M1–M4) and Windows 11?
items.answer: Yes. The macOS installer runs natively on both Apple Silicon and Intel Macs, and the Windows installer supports 64-bit Windows 10 and 11.
